name: high-concurrency-flash-sale
description: Educational demo: preventing oversell in a high-concurrency flash sale (naive PostgreSQL vs Redis reservation + queue)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api -w apps/api" "npm run dev:worker -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
